en: Sappītikaduka (The Pair on Being Accompanied by Rapture)
Dependent on a state that is not accompanied by rapture (*nasappītika*), a state that is not accompanied by rapture arises by way of the root condition (*hetupaccaya*) ... three.
Dependent on a state that is not accompanied by rapture, a state that is not accompanied by rapture arises by way of the root condition ... three.
Dependent on a state that is both not accompanied by rapture and not accompanied by rapture, a state that is not accompanied by rapture arises by way of the root condition ... three. (Abbreviated.)

In the case of the root condition, there are nine; ... pe ... in the case of the prenascence and repetition conditions, there are six; ... pe ... in the case of the non-disappearance condition, there are nine.
